neighbours.label: The chopped-off word piece 'EA'/'ea' (also 'EO', 'MEA') when a longer acronym, name or code string splits so that piece stands alone: EEA, OEA, UEA, EMEA, EEOC, Medea, Sacagawea, apnoea, base64 '...AQEA...'. Weaker second trigger: a lone 'a' or 'o' piece right after an 'e' piece (Boadicea, NCEA, Tadeo). Quiet for whole words holding 'ea' (idea, area, beach; tea/sea only weak), whole-token acronyms and names (CEO, Korea, Samoa), acronyms where 'EA' is fused into a bigger piece (IAEA), and -ae endings (Mycenae).
neighbours.short: split-off 'EA'/'ea' piece in acronyms and names
fire: The trade agreement extends single-market rules across the entire EEA, including Norway and Iceland.
She filed a discrimination complaint with the EEOC last spring.
Our sales director oversees the EMEA region from the London office.
He completed his doctorate in environmental sciences at UEA in Norwich.
In the play, Medea takes a terrible revenge on Jason.
Sacagawea guided the expedition across the mountains in 1805.
The child was diagnosed with obstructive sleep apnoea after a sleep study.
The encoded key began with MIIBIjANBgkqhkiG9w0BAQEAAOCAQ8A and continued for several lines.
